text:
dave: Heads-up: Compliance asked for a quick preview of audit payloads before download. Thinking: show estimated size, sample event count, and a tiny 7-day change sparkline inline in the exports table. Could save them from pulling huge bundles.
maria: Nice. We should also require a short justification for exports > 50MB and mark exports that include "sensitive_assertions" so legal can triage.
kevin: Implementation Qs: where do we compute the size estimator? Fast path: estimate from hourly telemetry + index stats. We can return size_estimate_bytes in export creation response.
sachin: Agree. We already have per-resource/day stats. Proposal: keep preview generation off the critical path. API behavior: POST starts async export build; separate preview endpoint pulls precomputed stats or runs a lightweight sampler. Suggest returning a small unicode sparkline (keeps payload tiny). Example preview payload shape: {size_estimate_bytes, sample_events (up to 10), sparkline: "▁▂▃▂▁▁▇"} — all server-side computed, cached for 24h. Emit telemetry event audit.export.preview_requested.
olivia: Ops caveat: concurrent bulk downloads killed bandwidth in one tenant test. Propose defaults: concurrent_downloads=3, daily_export_bytes=5GB per-tenant, presigned link TTL=1h. For heavier use, provide mode=staged where we assemble the bundle into long-term storage with TTL (7d) and a single download URL.
kevin: Console UX: show a small preview button in the exports table that opens a modal with the sample events, size estimate, and sparkline. If sensitive_assertions_present=true show a red banner and require a confirmation step and justification.
compliance-bot: Logged compliance request #892: "preview+justification+download-guards" and attached initial requirements.
dave: Very important: do NOT block export creation on preview generation. Return 202 and export_id; preview should be produced from cached aggregates or produced asynchronously.
sachin: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/audit/exports
{ "mode":"staged", "include_preview":true, "filters":{...} }
-> 202 { "export_id":"exp_123", "preview_available":false }
GET /v1/audit/exports/exp_123/preview
-> { "size_estimate_bytes":"123456789", "sample_events":["event1","event2"], "sparkline":"▁▂▃▂▁▁▇", "sensitive_assertions_present":"true" }
```
Also emit telemetry: audit.export.requested (props: tenant_id, mode, include_preview), audit.export.staged_completed, audit.export.presigned_issued.
maria: UX ask: if estimate > 2GB show a warning and offer staged flow with optional email notification when bundle is ready. For exports >100MB require a 1-line reason. Add admin override toggle.
olivia: I'll prototype nginx concurrent-download gates and add a background job to assemble staged bundles. I'll also add metric export.staged.size_bytes and an alert if a single tenant exceeds 10GB/day.
kevin: Security/PII: default redact_actor_emails=true unless tenant feature-flag show_full_actors is enabled. Also add sensitive_assertions_present boolean to export metadata.
dave: Ok let's lock API shape in a 20m sync tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
